name: Nahash
title: King of the Ammonites
summary: Nahash was the king over the Ammonites who threatened the city of Jabesh in Gilead with gouging out the right eye of all its inhabitants. His cruel ultimatum led Saul to gather Israel for battle and win a decisive victory. Nahash is also mentioned later in connection with kindness toward David, which led to diplomatic contact between the two kingdoms.

keyEvents.title: The Siege of Jabesh in Gilead
keyEvents.description: Nahash besieged Jabesh in Gilead and demanded that all its inhabitants let him gouge out their right eye as a disgrace over all Israel.

keyEvents.title: Jabesh Asks for Time
keyEvents.description: The people of Jabesh asked for seven days to send messengers throughout Israel to ask for help, and Nahash agreed to this.

keyEvents.title: Saul's Victory Over Nahash
keyEvents.description: Saul gathered the army of Israel and defeated the Ammonites under Nahash in a surprise attack at Jabesh, which strengthened Saul's kingdom.

keyEvents.title: Nahash's Kindness to David
keyEvents.description: Nahash showed kindness to David, which David remembered and wished to repay when Nahash died.

keyEvents.title: David's Messengers to Hanun
keyEvents.description: When Nahash died, David sent messengers to his son Hanun to comfort him, but Hanun humiliated them, leading to war.

keyEvents.title: Parallel Account in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: The event of David sending messengers to Hanun, the son of Nahash, is also recorded in 1 Chronicles, confirming the friendly relationship between David and Nahash.
